historical_scope: This file preserves the pre-device environment stop. It is not the current TARO device status.

implementation.contract: The camera-only canary accepts only timestamp-advancing, continuously tracked camera poses expressed relative to one tracked local ARCore Anchor in one Session; rejected admission never enters history; selector returns frame identity and pose deltas only.

local_tests.coverage: default-off, pose/clock/frame/quality fail-closed behavior and deterministic generic selection
VIO and anchor admission rejection do not buffer; admitted camera-only receipt selects; expired history is removed
project-owned ARCore anchor-relative pose-diverse instrumentation canary compiles; this is not device execution

remaining_device_gate.required_layer: project-owned instrumentation on an identified ARCore-capable device
must_prove: continuous tracking warm-up and a tracked local Anchor
camera poses expressed relative to the same Anchor in the same ARCore Session rather than direct EPHEMERAL_PER_FRAME world-pose numbers
at least 0.02m selected translation or 0.0349066rad selected yaw diversity
selection receipt only; no risk or guidance output
remaining_device_gate.separate_extrinsics_boundary: Camera-to-body extrinsics remain mandatory before any body-frame or risk-field warp, but are outside this camera-history selector canary.

claim_ceiling: Local core and isolated-harness implementation/test evidence only. Device execution is not evaluable because no device or AVD is ready; not product, default-App, or safety evidence.
